name: 32-hono-bearer-token-list
title: Unify single and multiple token checks in bearerAuth
body: Normalize the `token` option to an array so a single token and a list of tokens go through one code path instead of two separate branches.

bugs.why: Replaces timingSafeEqual with Array.includes (plain string equality), making token comparison timing-attackable and silently ignoring the hashFunction option.
